description: This file implements MKLDNN (oneDNN) optimized matrix multiplication functions for PyTorch, including support checks, different data types, and fallback mechanisms when MKLDNN is not enabled.

methods.name: mkldnn_matmul
methods.description: Performs MKLDNN optimized matrix multiplication or asserts failure if MKLDNN support is not enabled.

methods.name: use_mkldnn_bf16_matmul
methods.description: Checks if BF16 MKLDNN matmul is supported for given tensors.

methods.name: use_mkldnn_fp16_matmul
methods.description: Checks if FP16 MKLDNN matmul is supported for given tensors.

methods.name: mkldnn_bf16_gemm
methods.description: Performs BF16 GEMM operation using MKLDNN.

methods.name: mkldnn_fp16_gemm
methods.description: Performs FP16 GEMM operation using MKLDNN.

methods.name: mkldnn_reduced_f32_gemm
methods.description: Performs reduced precision GEMM with float32 support.

methods.name: mkldnn_matmul_i8i8i32
methods.description: Performs int8x8 GEMM resulting in int32 output, using either primitive or BLAS API.
